The foreground bagel is in sharp focus, displaying a golden-brown crust with scattered coarse salt crystals and characteristic surface blistering. A central hole is visible, though partially obscured by the angle and depth of field. The background bagel is slightly out of focus, topped with sesame seeds. Both sit on a light-colored, textured surface, likely parchment paper.
